definitions.gloss: truth; true facts; the real situation
definitions.explanation: The actual facts behind an event or situation, especially one that has been unclear, hidden, or disputed. Often used in the context of investigations, mysteries, or scandals.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真相|しんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To investigate the truth behind the incident.

examples.japanese: {真相|しんそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{分|わ}からない→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧ままだ。
examples.english: The truth remains unknown to everyone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、ようやく⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真相|しんそう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{明|あき}らか→明らか：02351_akiraka⟧になった。
examples.english: After years of investigation, the truth behind the accident was finally revealed.

notes:
USAGE:
Used when referring to hidden or disputed facts, not for everyday truths. Frequently appears in news, detective stories, and discussions of scandals or unsolved cases.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真相|しんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あき}らかにする→明らかにする：22256_akirakanisuru⟧ (to reveal the truth)
- {真相|しんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}き{止|と}める→突き止める：09344_tsukitomeru⟧ (to get to the bottom of the truth)
- {真相|しんそう}⟦{究明|きゅうめい}→究明：17549_kyuumei⟧ (investigation of the truth)
- ⟦{事件|じけん}→事件：01568_jiken⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{真相|しんそう} (the truth behind the incident)
- {真相|しんそう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{闇|やみ}→闇：14528_yami⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧ (the truth remains in the dark)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事実|じじつ}→事実：03271_jijitsu⟧: fact — a neutral, objective term; does not imply anything was hidden
- ⟦{真実|しんじつ}→真実：05316_shinjitsu⟧: truth — more philosophical and emotional; the deeper truth of a matter
